scope: Bounded native acceptance passed against python-oracledb 26.1.0 Thin and Oracle AI Database 26ai Free server 23.26.3.0.0 (AL32UTF8). Supported relational/document workflows include scalar and bounded CLOB/BLOB/native JSON tables, typed scalar JSON paths, reports, snapshots, transactions and external-table idempotency; this does not qualify Thick mode, Enterprise/RAC/Autonomous, licensed options or the entire Database API.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_oracle.py with a dedicated interpreter containing the latest stable python-oracledb and a disposable schema on the latest stable accessible Oracle Database Free; require baseline/variant relational reports, exact NUMBER/Unicode/NULL cases, load row accounting, transaction commit/rollback/savepoint/constraint cases, cross-session isolation, hostile saved-evidence, credential-redaction and lifecycle cases.
Record the observed driver, server, platform and image identities in the receipt; Free-edition evidence does not prove Enterprise, RAC, Autonomous or licensed-option behaviour.
